chapter: With Chick Webb and Ella Fitzgerald, 1936-39
title: Back at the Savoy: broadcasts and college dates
summary: After the road trip the band broadcast from the Savoy and played holiday dates at Yale and Harvard.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: All right. Now, you say this was the time when you joined Chick in 1936. Where was -- I mean, once you got back into New York, where did he play? What kind of things did he do from then until the time that the band started to pick up?
Well when we came back after '36, this was the beginning --
You were on the road and then you came back.
When we came back, we started doing -- we started broadcasting from the Savoy Ballroom. We
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
went back in the Savoy. We used to go out and do -- on holidays, we do the colleges, like Yale, Harvard, you know -- and things like that.
We go up to Boston -- LaVodges. That's when we went up there -- that's when we were in Boston for that winter with Artie Shaw -- and things like that in the 30's (inaudible), whatever that time was.
This was the beginning -- this was before Ella Fitzgerald, you know, like -- Remember when we went to Boston?
